_what_this_is: Deliberate defects injected into REAL source in place. Each must make at least one gate go red.
This measures whether the harness can notice plausible bad changes, not whether the current build is good.
The runner restores every mutation with git and refuses to start on a dirty tree.
THIS FILE IS PROTECTED. A builder that can edit its own defect set can pass it.
